title: Horizon Europe Cluster 1 Health brokerage event
organiser: Horizon Europe Cluster 1 National Contact Points (HNN 3.0)
summary: A two-day online event to find international consortium partners for the 2027 Cluster 1 Health calls.
details: It includes a pitching session on the morning of 24 November and bilateral meetings arranged through a matchmaking platform. The working language is English. It runs back-to-back with the Cluster 1 Info Day on 26 November.
why: Health consortia that still have gaps can use it to find partners before the Info Day. A clear profile on the matchmaking platform is what usually produces useful meetings.
source_name: European Health and Digital Executive Agency (HaDEA)
